tooltip.extrautilitiesrebirth.wireless.l: Right-click a receiver with a Wrench, then right-click the battery.
tooltip.extrautilitiesrebirth.wireless.u: Sneak-right-click the battery to remove the selected link.
tooltip.extrautilitiesrebirth.angel_ring: Flight is available in Angel Ring by DenisMasterHerobrine
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.title: Extra Utilities
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.quarry_marker: Set four Ender Markers at the same height. Right-click the corner that will touch the quarry to link the rectangle.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.quarry_output: If an Ender Quarry stalls, check its output chest. It keeps rejected drops and resumes when they have somewhere to go.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.quarry_silk_t: Place a Silk Touch upgrade against the Ender Quarry to bring home ore blocks. Budget five times the power draw.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.quarry_world_: Want the hole as much as the ore? Put a World Hole Upgrade next to the Ender Quarry so it leaves air instead of dirt.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.thermic_pump_: Set a drum directly on top of an Ender Thermic Pump. A tank next to it won't catch the fluid.
The first source an Ender Thermic Pump collects decides whether it pumps water or lava for that run.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.ender_lilies: Right-click a ripe Ender Lily for a pearl without breaking the plant. Ender Core makes the next one grow faster.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.generator_red: If a fueled generator reads zero, check the redstone button. Signal needs power from redstone. Ignore doesn't.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.generator_buf: A full energy buffer pauses a generator's burn. Give it somewhere to send the power before adding more fuel.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.generator_spe: Speed upgrades make a generator burn through fuel faster. The total Forge Energy you get from each item stays the same.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.tnt_generator: The TNT Generator accepts TNT through its fuel slot. The flint and steel can stay in the chest.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.magma_generat: Right-click a Magma Generator with a lava bucket to fill it. A fluid pipe can do the same job without the walk.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.rainbow_gener: The Rainbow Generator needs all 16 fuel generators making power at once. A full generator can drop you back to 15.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.wireless_link: Right-click the receiver with a Wrench, then right-click the Wireless FE Battery. Keep them less than ten blocks apart.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.wireless_unli: To unlink a wireless machine, select it with the Wrench again, then sneak-right-click the battery.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.moonlit_shift: Solar Panels make 10 FE/t by day. Lunar Panels make 15 FE/t by night. Both need a clear view of the sky.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.gold_chest: A Gold Chest holds 54 slots in one block. Useful when you have room for exactly one more storage solution.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.golden_bag: A Golden Bag of Holding has 54 slots and can't hold another Golden Bag. This is where the filing system ends.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.fluid_deliver: Drums keep their contents when mined. Moving the drum beats making 256 trips with a bucket.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.drum_comparat: A comparator can read how full a drum is. You may still knock on the side if it helps.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.trash_can: An Item Trash Can deletes its contents on the next tick. This is a very short return policy.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.sorting_machi: Rename a Name Tag to forge:ores and put it in the Sorter's filter slot. Facing the front, ores go right.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.inventory_int: The Inventory Interface is a ten-slot buffer for hoppers and pipes. It has no menu, so bring a hopper to get your items back.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.resonator_sto: Feed Polished Stone into the Resonator to get Stoneburnt for 8,000 FE. Ordinary Stone won't do.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.enchanter_upg: To make Quarry Speed II, give the Enchanter a Speed I block and an Efficiency III book. It consumes the book.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.mechanical_mi: The Mechanical Miner breaks the block directly in front of it. Put a cobblestone generator there and pull the drops out with a hopper.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.mechanical_us: Put one potato in a Mechanical User set to Drop Item and point it at a friend's doorway. The least efficient room service.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.angel_block: Look into empty space and right-click with an Angel Block to place the first block of a sky build.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.chandelier: Hang a Chandelier from a solid ceiling to stop natural hostile spawns within 16 blocks. It won't evict the ones already there.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.cursed_earth: Light level 9 stops Cursed Earth from spreading or spawning mobs. Light the room before laying the floor.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.mob_spikes: Use Gold Spikes for experience or Diamond Spikes for loot that requires a player kill. Diamond Spikes don't give XP.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.portable_glob: Use the Portable Globe in the Overworld to save a return spot. Use it in another dimension when you've had enough of that dimension.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.chunk_wand: A placed Chunk Loading Wand keeps its own chunk ticking. Check the chunk border before you blame the far end of the machine.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.glass_cutter: Right-click glass or panes with a Glass Cutter to recover them. The reinforced version takes no wear on placed glass.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.ethereal_door: Put Ethereal Glass in a doorway and call it staff only. The actual dress code is standing up.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.inverted_glas: Stand on Inverted Ineffable Glass and it holds you up. Crouch and you pass through. Mention that before the tour.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.precision_she: Sneak-right-click a suitable block with Precision Shears to put it straight in your inventory. Leave a slot free.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.fire_axe: The Fire Axe fells connected logs, including ones that touch at a corner. This is excellent unless the tree is your house.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.golden_lasso: Name a pig Management before moving it with a Golden Lasso. It keeps its name and all of its existing qualifications.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.chicken_wing_: The Advanced Chicken Wing Ring stops fall damage while carried. It spends durability when it saves you, so check it before jumping.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.demon_ingots: Make Demon Ingots by dropping gold into lava walled in with Nether Bricks on all four sides. Without the walls, you're just throwing away gold.
tips.extrautilitiesrebirth.field_guide: With Patchouli installed, craft a book, redstone dust, and cyan dye together for the Extra Utilities Guide.
